More Info Visit Apply Give Students Faculty / Staff Alumni Skip to content Office of Admissions Discover Your Path to Success: Start Your Journey with Our Admissions Team Apply Now Admissions Welcome Welcome to the Office of Admissions & Recruitment at Medgar Evers College. Our team is available to assist you with all admissions related inquiries. Check out our FAQs for answers to common admissions questions. You can also reach us via e-mail or by calling 718-270-6024 . Our office is located in the Student Services Building and is open Monday-Friday from 9am-4:45pm, with the exception of major holidays. Please contact the Office of Admissions & Recruitment at Medgar Evers College for information about application deadlines. Freshman Applicant Take the first step toward your college journey. Explore programs designed to set the foundation for your future success. Freshman Information Transfer Applicant Continue your academic journey with us. Seamlessly transition and build on your accomplishments. Transfer Information International Applicant Join a vibrant, global community. Discover the support and resources available to help you succeed. International Information Non-Degree Applicant Enhance your knowledge without committing to a full degree program. Explore flexible learning opportunities tailored to your goals. Non-degree Information Other Applicants Re-admit Applicants Apply for Readmission if you are a former student who attended Medgar Evers College as degree-seeking student and have not been in attendance for one or more semesters. Re-admit Information Veteran and Military Applicants Medgar Evers College is dedicated to providing culturally responsive admissions, academic and transitional support to MEC veterans, military personnel and their dependents. Office of Veteran & Military Services The Application Process Follow these steps to successfully apply 01 Track Track Deadlines Make note of application postmark deadlines and admission notification dates. 02 Submit Submit Your Application Log into the CUNY Application using either a guest account or your CUNYfirst account. 03 Send Send Your Documents After submitting your application, be sure to provide all required documents. 04 Check Check Your Status Once you submit your application, we’ll send you an email to log into CUNYfirst. Support for Parents & Families At Medgar Evers College, we recognize the important role parents and families play in a student’s academic journey. We are committed to providing the resources and information you need to support your student from admission to graduation. Learn more about the admissions process, financial aid, student support services, and ways to stay involved.
